name: Barbell Bench Press
description: Lying on a flat bench, lower the barbell to your chest with control and press it up explosively. The king of pushing exercises.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
description: On a bench inclined at 30-45 degrees, press dumbbells upwards. Focuses on the upper portion of the pectorals.

name: Cable Flyes
description: Standing tall, pull the cables from a high position to the center of your chest. Maintains constant tension on the pecs.

name: Pushups
description: Classic bodyweight exercise. Keep your body straight like a plank and lower until your chest almost touches the floor.

name: Dips
description: Suspend your body on parallel bars and lower by bending your elbows. Lean torso forward to target the chest.

name: Pullups
description: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip and pull yourself up until your chin passes the bar. Fundamental for back width.

name: Barbell Bent Over Row
description: Hinging at the hips with a flat back, pull the barbell towards your abdomen. Builds back density and thickness.

name: Lat Pulldown
description: Seated at a machine, pull the bar down towards your upper chest. Excellent alternative to pullups.

name: Seated Cable Row
description: Seated with legs slightly bent, pull the attachment towards your abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together.

name: Straight Arm Pulldown
description: Standing with straight arms, push the bar from eye level down to your hips. Isolates the lats without using biceps.

name: Barbell Squat
description: The king of leg exercises. Barbell on traps, lower your hips breaking parallel with your knees.

name: Leg Press
description: Push the platform away with your feet. Allows moving heavy weight without loading the lower back.

name: Walking Lunges
description: Step forward and lower your back knee towards the ground. Targets quads, glutes, and balance.

name: Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
description: With legs slightly bent, lower the barbell keeping it close to your shins by pushing hips back. Focuses on hamstrings.

name: Leg Extension
description: Seated in the machine, extend your legs until knees are locked. Pure quadriceps isolation.

name: Lying Leg Curl
description: Lying face down, curl your heels towards your glutes. Isolates the hamstrings.

name: Standing Calf Raise
description: Standing or in a machine, raise your heels by extending your ankles. Essential for calf development.

name: Overhead Press (OHP)
description: Standing tall, press the barbell from your chest to fully overhead. Massive shoulder builder.

name: Lateral Raises
description: With dumbbells, raise arms out to the sides until shoulder height. Creates shoulder width (side delts).

name: Reverse Flyes
description: Bent over, raise dumbbells out to the sides. Targets the rear deltoids for 3D shoulders.

name: Face Pulls
description: Using a rope on a high pulley, pull towards your forehead separating your hands. Crucial for shoulder health.

name: Barbell Bicep Curl
description: Standing, curl the barbell towards your chest while keeping elbows tucked. The gold standard for biceps.

name: Hammer Curl
description: With dumbbells in a neutral grip (palms facing each other), curl up. Targets the brachialis and forearms.

name: Tricep Pushdown
description: Standing at a cable machine, push the bar or rope down until elbows are fully extended.

name: Skullcrushers
description: Lying on a bench, lower the EZ bar towards your forehead by bending elbows, then extend back up.

name: Bench Dips
description: Hands on a bench behind you, feet on another bench or floor. Lower hips by bending elbows. Targets triceps.

name: Plank
description: Hold an isometric position supported by forearms and toes. Strengthens the entire core and abs.

name: Crunches
description: Lying on your back, flex your torso trying to bring ribs towards hips. Basic ab isolation.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
description: Hanging from a bar, lift your legs until they form a 90-degree angle or touch the bar.

name: Burpees
description: Full body movement: pushup followed by a jump squat. Burns calories rapidly.

name: Jump Rope
description: Continuous jumping over a rope. Excellent for cardiovascular endurance and coordination.

name: Mountain Climbers
description: From a plank position, drive knees to chest alternately at high speed.

name: Kettlebell Swing
description: Hinge movement swinging a kettlebell using hip power. Targets posterior chain and cardio.

name: Thrusters
description: A combination of a front squat and an overhead press in one fluid motion.
